_readme: Example reference data for a pilot database (npm run db:bootstrap -- server/pilot-bootstrap.json). Copy this file, replace every REPLACE value with real information, and delete entries you do not need. It loads reference data only; batteries arrive through intake and CSV import. Test protocols stay 'placeholder' until engineering approves a protocol and acceptance criteria.

families.ratingConditions: REPLACE e.g. C10 to 1.80 V/cell at 25 °C, from the datasheet

protocols.name: Intake inspection
protocols.summary: REPLACE with the engineering-approved intake procedure reference. Do not store chemical recipes or safety procedures here.

protocols.name: Capacity test
protocols.summary: REPLACE with the engineering-approved capacity test reference and acceptance criterion.

importTemplates.name: Synovra standard intake
importTemplates.description: One row per physical battery, canonical column names.
